result.plainSummary: The plan makes proof visible without pretending older completion records verify today’s code.
result.summary: Reviewed written W-009 plan and tool-built related pack (1 feature, 3 claims, 38 docs, 20 turns). Compatible with SL-021 separation and SL-022 integrity-checked evidence: slice-scoped current checks are distinct from recorded artifacts, missing mappings stay explicit, exact SL-Turn joins replace pre-close HEAD attribution, and historical completion never restamps proof. Acceptance names temporary Git histories, failing/stale/missing cases and rendered/browser ordering. No blocking spec gaps. Re-reviewed user-authorized extension across all completed workstreams: current test-backed criterion mappings and implementation/review records may be renewed, original sealed intent and historical facts must be preserved, and unsupported criteria must remain explicit gaps. Expanded packages/** scope permits real behavioral regression coverage; no requirement to claim universal green.
residualRisks: Related pack supplies only a caution-only worktree scan notice, not verified sibling-worktree findings.
Older workstreams may lack criterion mappings or historical per-criterion proof; UI must disclose absence and cannot infer verification from completion status.
